objective: Candidate separates ceramic media from washers into different retained/recovered locations; PR 2063 transfers chopped walnuts from a processor bowl while safely managing the removable blade.
physical_skill: PR 2063 tests pouring or scraping contents around a hazardous loose blade and safely stowing that blade. The candidate tests bimanual screen grasping, selective passage, washer retention, and precise support replacement.
success_condition: PR 2063 scores walnut mass in the mixing bowl, penalizes unsafe blade states, and requires blade stowage for full credit. The candidate scores recovered media mass plus complete washer retention, valid passage, no spill or breakage, screen support, release, and dwell.
reason: Both involve separating contents from a retained component, but PR 2063 is guarded bulk transfer around one blade rather than geometry-based classification of mixed loose bodies.
